_doc: tools/fetch_fish.py --refill (Pierre, 2026-11-06, Q171): per fish.json species id, the parts of its candidate room searched to the end on iNaturalist (at: the day; room: per part, free = the general searches, juvenile / male / female = the phase searches, the room it had left, which a new observation fits; cap: the species' cap then). A part is searched to the end when its searches were read to their end with that room left. The species is skipped while every open part was searched to the end less than 30 days ago with at least the room it has now, under a cap at least the one it has now. Written by the Candidate photos workflow.
